items.transcript: Here's how to clean smarter, not harder. For oil stains, mix dish soap and baking soda into a paste, rub it in, then wash as usual. This thing makes cleaning your stove so much quicker and easier with zero scrubbing required. Sprinkle baking soda over rugs and carpets, let it sit, then vacuum to remove odors. And to make your towels feel like new again, replace fabric softener with white vinegar to keep them soft, fresh, and prevent buildup.

How to keep your towels soft, fluffy and fresh 🧺✨

Wash towels in their own load, add baking soda to help freshen them, and swap fabric softener for white vinegar. Go easy on detergent, too much can leave residue behind, so use the right amount and a good-quality detergent.

Wash warm, tumble dry on low, and make sure towels are fully dry before storing. I also like washing bath towels every 3–4 uses to keep them fresh.

items.transcript: I made this frame for our TV, and it honestly is so much easier than it looks. I used a few pieces of wood, cut the ends at an angle, and joined them together with brackets. Then I added some decorative details, filled any gaps, and sprayed everything black. Once that dried, I added gold spray paint to give it that vintage look. I added elastic to the back to keep the frame secure around the TV, and that's it! It's such a simple DIY, but adds so much character to the room. Let me know what you guys think.

items.transcript: Here are a few cleaning hacks you need to know. Got a smelly drain? Add baking soda and lemon juice, let it sit for 15 minutes, then rinse it with hot water to freshen it up. Add a bowl of foil to the dishwasher, run a normal cycle, and let it help bring the shine back to your silverware. If you love clean floors but hate mopping, a steaming scrub cleaner makes the job so much easier. If you want to reuse a candle jar, pop it in the freezer for a few hours, the wax comes out so easy and the jar is ready to reuse.

items.transcript: Welcome back to Clean Smart and learn how to fight 12. If you forget a load in the washer, add white vinegar on a quick cycle and say goodbye to that musty smell. To help keep bugs out, spray on peppermint and oil mix around windows, doors, and other entry points. For dust, mix water and white vinegar, a little olive oil, and essential oil. It cleans the surface and helps slow down dust from settling back. And try a stainless steel chopping board. Non-porous, easy to clean, won't absorb odors or stains.
